Senior Financial Analyst (CPA) – Mining

Department:
Finance

Reports To:
Director of Finance

Location:
Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

Blue Moon Metals is seeking a
Senior Financial Analyst
to join our growing Finance team. This role will play a key part in supporting financial reporting, IFRS compliance, operational analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. The ideal candidate is a recently qualified CPA with experience in the mining sector, strong technical accounting expertise, and a collaborative approach to partnering across corporate and operational teams.

Key Responsibilities

Support the preparation, consolidation, and analysis of monthly management reporting packages, quarterly financial statements, and annual financial reporting in accordance with IFRS

Assist in preparing Management Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) disclosures, technical accounting assessments, audit working papers, and IFRS accounting analyses

Partner closely with Corporate Accounting and site finance teams to improve the accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of financial information and reporting processes

Serve as an internal IFRS technical resource and provide accounting guidance to operational finance teams

Support external reporting requirements, including filings for TSX Venture Exchange, Nasdaq, and other regulatory reporting obligations

Prepare supporting schedules, variance analysis, and reporting documentation for internal and external stakeholders

Collaborate with operational and project teams to analyze mine development, construction, and exploration expenditures

Support ERP and financial systems initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA implementation activities, financial reporting enhancements, and internal control improvements

Participate in ad hoc financial analysis, process optimization initiatives, and strategic projects

Contribute to continuous improvement efforts within the financial reporting function to support a growing mining organization

Qualifications & Experience

Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline

CPA designation required

3–6 years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience

Previous experience within the mining industry strongly preferred

Strong understanding of IFRS accounting standards; exposure to US GAAP considered an asset

Public accounting experience, particularly within a Big 4 mining practice, is considered a strong asset

Experience supporting publicly traded company reporting requirements considered an asset

Proficiency with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills

Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively across technical and operational teams

Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Development opportunities via department rotation

Compensation and benefits details will be discussed during the interview process.

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

jobs.locationRaw: Reporting to Nussir ASA, Repparfjord or Alta, Troms og Finnmark, Norway
jobs.description:
Nussir søker erfaren regnskapsfører

Ønsker du å bidra til verdiskapning og bolyst i Finnmark? Ønsker du å være med fra starten i et betydelig og svært spennende selskap med internasjonal hverdag? Ønsker du å bo i nord og gi andre muligheten til det samme?

Gruveprosjektet Nussir har stor fremdrift og søker en erfaren autorisert regnskapsfører.

Nussir er en del av det børsnoterte konsernet Blue Moon Metals Inc. som er listet på TSX og NASDAQ. Den norske delen av konsernet har i dag seksti ansatte og forventer sterk vekst frem til stabil produksjon i 2028.

Stillingen har følgende ansvarsområder:

Lede den regnskapsmessige overgangen fra konstruksjonsfasen til produksjon

Ansvar for selskapets regnskapsføring og regnskapsprosesser

Utarbeidelse av måneds-, kvartals- og årsregnskap

Sikre etterlevelse av gjeldende lover, regler og regnskapsstandarder

Ansvar for skatte- og avgiftsrapportering

Koordinering og oppfølging av revisjon

Videreutvikling av interne rutiner, prosesser og kontroller via SAP

Bidra til budsjett-, prognose- og rapporteringsprosesser

Delta i finansielle analyser og beslutningsunderlag for ledelsen

Samarbeid med eksterne rådgivere, myndigheter og øvrige forretningsområder

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

Autorisert regnskapsfører

Høyere økonomisk utdannelse innen regnskap, revisjon eller økonomi

Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring innen regnskap, revisjon eller økonomistyring

Solid kompetanse innen norsk regnskapsregelverk

Internasjonal og IFRS erfaring er en fordel

Erfaring med årsoppgjør, skatt og avgift

God systemforståelse og erfaring med ERP-systemer, erfaring med SAP er en fordel

Meget gode ferdigheter i Excel

God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Stillingen byr på betydelige muligheter for læring og vekst, og en del av et konsern i sterk vekst. Stillingen vil ha påvirkningsmulighet i forhold etableringen av et gruveprosjekt i Kvalsund og målsetning om å benytte tid i gruven og prosessanlegget. Nussir seeks an experienced Chief Accountant

Would you like to contribute to value creation and help strengthen local communities in Finnmark? Would you like to join a significant and highly exciting company from the ground up, operating in an international environment? Do you want to live in Northern Norway and help create opportunities for others to do the same?
The Nussir mining project is making strong progress and is seeking an experienced Certified Accountant to join our team.

Nussir is part of the publicly listed Blue Moon Metals Inc. group, which is listed on both the TSX and NASDAQ stock exchanges. The Norwegian operations currently employ approximately sixty people and are expected to experience significant growth leading up to stable production in 2028.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage the accounting transition from construction to production

Responsibility for the company's accounting operations and financial processes

Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and accounting standards

Responsibility for tax and VAT reporting

Coordinate and manage external audits

Further develop internal routines, processes, and controls

Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes

Participate in financial analysis and the preparation of decision support for management

Collaborate with external advisors, authorities, and other business functions

Desired Qualifications:

Certified Accountant (Authorized Accountant)

Higher education in Accounting, Auditing, Finance, or Economics

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in accounting, auditing, or financial management

Strong knowledge of Norwegian accounting regulations; experience with IFRS is an advantage

Experience with year-end closing, taxation, and VAT reporting

Strong systems understanding and experience with ERP systems

International and SAP experience is an advantage

Advanced Excel skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English

The position offers significant opportunities for learning and professional growth as part of a rapidly expanding group. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to influence the development of the mining project in Kvalsund and will be expected to spend time both at the mine site and at the processing plant. Candidates are expected to spend a minimum of five working days per month in Repparfjord. The office location is either Hammerfest or Alta.

The position reports to the Head of Finance Norway. For further information regarding the position, please contact Alexander Krogh at +47 416 48 650.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Field Operations Lead

About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Work collaboratively with data scientist colleagues to conceive and implement insightful analytical methods

Qualifications

A great Senior Exploration Geologist candidate will have:

Strong technical knowledge of one or more ore deposit types. Experience working on sediment-hosted stratiform copper or magmatic sulfide deposits will be considered an advantage

Strong leadership skills including the ability to motivate and inspire others, to share ownership and responsibility for project outcomes, and to work effectively in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams

About the company:

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Rice and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

About The Role:

In this role, you will develop state of the art instruments to collect data to guide our exploration programs. You will simulate, characterize, and calibrate sensor performance and design new data acquisition systems. Working with vendors and partners, you will build hardware and work with our operations staff to deploy it in the field.

With this sensor data and other data sources at KoBold, you will build models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will help build a worldwide dataset that underlies our exploration program, with careful attention to identifying and quantifying uncertainty in the data and in our predictions. You will be creating models and developing software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals.

You will join an outstanding team of data scientists and engineers and will work closely with KoBold’s world-renowned geoscientists to incorporate our best understanding of the chemical and physical processes that create ore deposits. Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will identify new opportunities and technologies for geophysical data collection, create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building and deploying next generation hardware and using data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up.

jobs.description:
Communities and Social Performance

About the company:

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

In this role, you will own the computation hydrogeology program for KoBold’s exploration projects, including pre-feasibility and feasibility engineering studies. You will help to create water management strategies that maximize the safety, feasibility, and value of future mines. Working closely with field hydrogeologists, mining engineers, and computational scientists, you will lead the development and execution of numerical simulations necessary for quantitative evaluation of the strategies you develop. Your analyses and groundwater flow models will be an integral component of KoBold’s dynamic mine-planning and mine-operations technology.

You will join an outstanding team of geoscientists, data scientists, and software engineers. You will be a core part of the project teams, advancing the science and practice of exploration. In addition to contributing to the development of novel data collection programs, you will work closely with geologists and data scientists to build physics-based and data-driven models of the hydrogeology of our exploration sites. A key challenge will be to quantify uncertainties relevant to mining, and to identify efficient means for reducing these uncertainties as the project advances.

Responsibilities

The Computational Hydrogeologist will:

Develop multiple alternative groundwater management strategies and quality metrics

Identify data and information needed to evaluate the efficacy of a proposed strategy, differentiate the system response from other possible strategies, and compare the strengths and weaknesses of various water management actions

Design data collection programs required to inform evaluation analyses and work with field teams to develop methodologies for execution

Build and run computational analyses, including numerical simulations of groundwater flow, post-processing algorithms for hydrogeologic insights, and uncertainty quantification

Work with data scientists to develop novel approaches and tools to extract value from results

Qualifications

A great Hydrogeologist candidate will have:

Bachelor's or post-graduate degree in hydrogeology, geology, computational geoscience, geological or environmental engineering, or closely related discipline

6-10 years of work experience, including at least 2 years in mining hydrogeology

Experience with the design and implementation of water management strategies for mining applications

Experience with the design and implementation of hydrogeologic field studies

Deep expertise in computational modeling of porous media flows and coupled groundwater/surface-water systems

Experience analyzing hydrogeologic data to support the development of conceptual and numerical models of groundwater flow, including familiarity with modeling software such as MODFLOW or FEFLOW

Enthusiasm for developing novel mathematical models, both physics-based and data-driven

Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.

Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not technical. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.

Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.

Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

Responsibilities

The Project Planner will:

Lead development of integrated, resource-loaded master schedules (Primavera P6) from concept through commissioning and close out, aligned to WBS/CBS standards.

Establish the schedule governance model (coding structures, calendars, fragnets, interfaces, and data quality checks) for all workstreams and contractors.

Drive baseline development (scope freeze assumptions, logic, critical/near‑critical path, milestones) and obtain formal approvals.

Build and maintain robust WBS/OBS/RBS structures and activity coding to enable multi-level reporting (program; project; area; system; subsystem).

Conduct critical path and driving-path analysis, total/ free float consumption tracking, and pathway-of-risk reviews.

Run trend analysis (SPI(t), schedule variance, progress curves, productivity indices) and produce leading indicators and early‑warning signals.

Build what‑if simulations and scenario models (alternate execution sequences, resequencing for access/permits, weather or logistics constraints).

Perform probabilistic schedule risk analysis (e.g., Monte Carlo) to quantify P‑dates, confidence levels, and criticality/sensitivity indices; propose mitigation and contingency plans.

Integrate with cost control to support Earned Value Management (EVM); reconcile schedule and cost performance (SPI/CPI) and explain variances.

Define progress measurement rules of credit and automate performance tracking at work‑package and system levels.

Generate rolling lookaheads (2–6 weeks), constraint logs, and readiness checks to support field execution.

Facilitate schedule risk reviews; maintain risk registers and link mitigations to schedule activities with measurable impacts.

Manage change control; quantify time impacts (TIA), maintain fragnet libraries, and support claims/extension‑of‑time narratives with forensic schedule analysis.

Lead recovery and resequencing plans when thresholds or KPIs are breached.

Integrate P6 with cost systems/ERP, document management, field progress apps, and (where applicable) 4D/BIM tools.

Establish data pipelines between P6 and BI tools (e.g., SQL/Power Query/DAX; Python a plus) to automate reporting and analytics.

Coach project teams and junior planners; codify playbooks, checklists, and reusable templates for the planning function.

About the Company

KoBold Metals Zambia Limited is a Zambian-led company exploring for the ore deposits that will become the next generation of new mines in Zambia.

KoBold Metals Zambia is the Zambian affiliate of KoBold Metals, a U.S.-based company exploring around the world for battery metals using proprietary AI to guide exploration decisions. Our business is discovering, defining, expanding, and developing mineral resources, and our objective is to achieve a step-change improvement in exploration success resulting in more tier 1 resources discovered faster, with fewer failures, and with far less exploration capital.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

KoBold Metals Zambia is building a rapidly growing team of Zambian geologists, operators, and executives to identify, acquire, explore, and develop exploration opportunities and mineral resources drawing upon KoBold’s technology and the expertise of colleagues worldwide.

About The Role:

The Civil Project Engineer will be responsible for the management of design, including preparation of drawings and specifications and construction of civil engineering works, structures, and infrastructure (including buildings) for the Mingomba Mine Project. You will be responsible for input into the prefeasibility and feasibility stages of the project where input from the civil discipline is required. You will also be responsible for monitoring the performance of civil construction contracts and reviewing variations where applicable. You will be responsible for building and fostering a collaborative relationship with all stakeholders including consultants, peer reviewers and suppliers.

You will join an outstanding team of geoscientists, data scientists, and software engineers. You will be a core part of the project teams, advancing the science and practice of exploration. You will help develop novel data collection and monitoring programs.

Reporting to the Project Controls Manager, responsibilities of this position include:

Ensures that innovative civil/structural detailed designs are completed following good engineering practices and in accordance with the required standards and specifications, industry standards, and the relevant legislation (quality of design).

Provides design interface between disciplines.

Ensures (certified) design information received from vendors, contractors and consultants is accurate and interfaces with other designs.

Ensures effective (peer) review and approval of discipline design are completed.

Ensure continuous improvement, lessons learned, value engineering, fit for purpose, and the latest technologies are implemented.

Carries the responsibility for the engineering discipline sign-off.

Interfaces with internal and external design and drafting disciplines.

Provides discipline inputs for studies and proposals.

Provides engineering support to the site team.

Manages the mark-up and back draughting of redline drawings.

Manages and mentors subordinators if applicable.

Qualifications

Our ideal candidate will have

A degree in Civil Engineering is essential

10 years minimum experience in the design, construction projects

Proven track record of bringing projects in on time, within budget and client approval.

Strong understanding of technical issues in relation to civil engineering in a mine environment

Strong report and proposal writing skills.

Ability to review reports, carry out audits, manage people, technical teams and providing mentoring and training.

In addition to the above, you will have:

Registered with the Engineering Institute of Zambia (EIZ)

Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment

Possess ability to analyze and understand complex technical information

Good leadership and motivational skills, with ability to get work done through others

We are committed to equal employment opportunities for all people.

This position is a full-time contract role.

Currently, we are only accepting applications from Zambian nationals.

Location: Zambia.

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.
